|lore=Infamous '''bounty hunter'''. Hired to help Jabba intimidate debtors and smugglers. Crack shot. Mandalorian armor and jet pack provide protection and flight capability.
|game_text=Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots (4 if ''Slave I''). May ‘fly’ (landspeed = 3). During battle, may target an opponent’s character present with Boba Fett. Draw destiny. Target captured if destiny +2 > ability. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 while with Han or Jabba).

|notes=Set 8 was released 24 November 2004. [https://web.archive.org/web/20041204170841id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/interior.htm Release announcement]. Both Set 8 publisher states use the Special Edition persona. The remaster moves capture from the just-initiated same-site window to during battle and names a target present with Boba Fett. It retains the ability threshold, Slave I pilot bonus and Han-or-Jabba immunity. The separately recovered Holotable file carries grappling-hook wording found in later Legacy, with a different Slave I bonus from the Legacy slip. [https://web.archive.org/web/20071203110335id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/cards/v8/ds/bobafett.gif Exact original-era Players Committee full face, captured 3 December 2007]. [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=2 Separate Legacy Block 1 collector 03E]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=135 Period capture example]. [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-holotable/blob/master/historical-recovery/419/large-v17/cards/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/bobafett.gif Later-content Holotable image] preserves the separate composite artifact.
